items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Mosley Interview, 1961-09-23
items.q: I started teaching him around in, oh, must have been around in 34.

ctx.x: Yeah. And I had everything to go with drum. Boat, whistle, tram whistle. Everything that consumed, you know, for drums during that time.
Well, when was it you started to teach your brother Edgar?
I started teaching him around in, oh, must have been around in 34. Oh, yeah.
